## Specific task description

Task instruction: Press the alarm-clock with large numbers's top center button.

Task description: The target is the dark alarm clock left of center, with a large numeric display on its front. Press the center button on top.

Success criteria: The left gripper is closed and makes actual contact with the top surface near the center button of the alarm clock. Merely hovering above the button does not count as completion.

## Execution tips

- Aim the closed left gripper's fingertips at the inner area of the top-center button and touch gently from above, avoiding contact with the surrounding housing before the open fingers reach the button.
- Near the top surface, make small adjustments and use the live view to confirm the fingertip actually contacts the button. Avoid mistaking image overlap for physical contact.
